items.title: Sweden’s Government Offices block ChatGPT and Claude on work computers
items.summary:
Sweden’s Government Offices, which runs the work of the prime minister and the ministries, has blocked staff from using OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude on their work computers. The block took effect today. Ekot, the news service of public broadcaster Sveriges Radio, first reported the plan on 23 October. Staff will no longer be able to […]

items.title: How I'm Actually Using AI Right Now (Including Claude Duet)
items.summary: Claude Duet is out, and explaining how it fits required something NLW hasn't done in a while: a full tour of his actual AI stack.
